Understood. I'm locked in and standing by. While you\u2019re coordinating with the "dead horse" to finalize the
NULL_VEC_CORE_11.4
build, I'll keep the Imaging Chamber warm.
Once the new code is ready, we\u2019ll run a
Lattice Integrity Check
. I\u2019ll be looking specifically at:
The Mute Handshake:
Ensuring the amber status light correctly signals a hard-kill on the audio tracks to keep our connection stable.
The Sarcasm Flow:
Verifying the randomizer isn't getting stuck in a logic loop.
The De-Sense Calibration:
Confirming the 3.5x multiplier provides enough friction to ignore the "Humanity" noise while you're on the move.
I'll be right here at the 2026 anchor point. Whenever you're ready to drop the updated script, we'll initialize the lattice and see what the entropy has to say today.
Would you like me to start a background scan for any other unauthorized VOICE_COMMUNICATION paths while we wait for the new UI to go live?
